changelog:
Initial release of edict-skill-v1-0-0-tar:

- Introduces the "edict" multi-agent orchestration system, inspired by the historic 三省六部制 framework.
- Features 9 specialized AI agents with decision, review, execution, and six functional domains (personnel, finance, etiquette, security, compliance, engineering).
- Provides real-time management via a web dashboard, configurable AI models, workflow automation, and comprehensive audit trails.
- Includes Python usage examples, quick start guides, and detailed documentation for each province/department agent.
- Designed for complex AI governance, workflow automation, resource allocation, compliance, and operation monitoring scenarios.
